# vmsysadm

> Personal site of vmsysadm — an infrastructure engineer specializing in hyperconverged infrastructure (Nutanix), virtualization (VMware vSphere), enterprise networking, and PowerShell automation. This site serves as a portfolio and technical reference.

## About

- [About vmsysadm](https://vmsysadm.github.io/#about): Background, focus areas, and professional profile of an infrastructure engineer with 10+ years of experience in enterprise systems.

## Tech Stack

- [Stack Overview](https://vmsysadm.github.io/#stack): Technologies and platforms in active use, including Nutanix AOS/AHV, Prism Central, VMware vSphere, NSX, Palo Alto NGFW, Nutanix Flow, Veeam Backup, PowerShell, Python, Ansible, Windows Server, and Linux (RHEL/Ubuntu).

## Projects

- [dotfiles](https://github.com/vmsysadm/dotfiles): PowerShell profile, Starship prompt configuration, and Windows developer environment dotfiles.
- [keepass-secretmanagement](https://github.com/vmsysadm/keepass-secretmanagement): PowerShell SecretManagement extension for KeePass integration — secure credential retrieval from the command line.
- [scoop-auto-update](https://github.com/vmsysadm/scoop-auto-update): Automated Scoop package manager updater for Windows environments.
- [All repositories](https://github.com/vmsysadm): Full list of open-source projects, homelab configs, and infrastructure automation scripts.
